62305.name: Architect Drive – First Strike
62305.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent <color=#F74848>2</color>-tile area to become a valid attack zone for ally Missile Launcher and Rocket Launcher attacks. Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+25%</color> for attacks induced by Backpack effects.
When initiating combat for the first time each turn: DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
